name: Michael Kors
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $135 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Handbags, shoes, watches and clothing, from the runway Michael Kors Collection (coats around $3,700) to the cheaper MICHAEL Michael Kors line, sold through own stores, website and department stores.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 1981 by Michael Kors.

price_read.sublines: Everything the US site sells as women's 'MICHAEL KORS' (the site no longer splits MICHAEL Michael Kors from Michael Kors Collection on tiles — all read 'MICHAEL KORS'); men's (C-prefixed style IDs) and kids' (J/O-prefixed) excluded; Watch Hunger Stop charity tees excluded

doors.note: 209 US (50-state) store pages + 2 Puerto Rico + 1 Guam = 212 rows. Counts include PR (1 own, 1 outlet) and exclude Guam (1 outlet, flagged) and Saddle Creek, Germantown TN (name reads "CLOSED"). Own = 60 incl. 4 Michael Kors Collection doors (Rodeo Dr, The Colony Palm Beach, Manhasset, 667 Madison). Outlets = 150 incl. 9 men's outlet doors (one, Leesburg Men's, not labelled Outlet but in Leesburg Corner Premium Outlets). 2 store pages 404 (Orlando Vineland, Sawgrass) — rows read from city listings. No department-store concessions are on the locator.
